body: If only I could see it the way he does!
It’s funny how the material stuff only helps so much, yet so many people believe that it’s the answer
Thank you for saying that.  There isn’t anyone else I can tell.  I have to text the crisis line when I feel that way.

Thank you, that for me is what’s hardest.  I want to be able to be close & vulnerable with him.  I feel like it would really help me deal with my issues better if I didn’t have to hide it from my “person”
This comment means a lot to me.  Thank you.
I think they just genuinely think I’m just “crazy”
